about: Ferrari 2026 steering wheel display: where to draw a canvas point (1670 x 942 mock-up px) so that it shows where a flat screen would show it. Offsets q - p in canvas px on the grid xs x ys; measured from a calibration grid screenshot (0.4.23), the bend inverted against a fitted flat mapping; cells outside the measured area hold the nearest measured offset. Second pass (0.4.25): the centre row's leftover, measured on the corrected grid, pushed down on the crease (rows 460-480), fading to nothing at the neighbouring grid rows.
